contracts.asserts: Actual production state/config types: edge recognition, start window, shared layer claims, settings races, independent contacts and transparent source KEY payload/sync; final button disposition only in composition

limits: Eight native scenarios exercise actual layer state/listeners with public processor events and one real input route; physical split delivery and exhaustive concurrent interleavings remain separate.

kernel_contracts.asserts: Eight native scenarios: invalid listener, neutral transition coordinate with preserved sync, transparent buttons, shared layer claims, per-node/all-stream disable cleanup, external layer ownership and actual listener/final-filter delayed-tap suppression with first fresh contact recovery

execution.default: quick: every behavioral fixture and scenario under ASan/UBSan once
execution.full: ZMK_TEST_MODE=full: same scenarios plus optimized, coverage and existing 32-bit variants
execution.integration: owner native/DTS/API guards when interfaces or kernel contracts change; not a prerequisite for pure host behavior
execution.transport: actual ordered USB/BLE/split/power/reset evidence; archived simulation is not a passing substitute

fixtures.asserts: Actual full runtime entry rejects empty, unrelated and partially measured coverage; normal full runs retain measured lines/branches for every real function

Exact supported core/dependency pins, clean sources, missing inputs, nonoverlapping project paths separate from west/config metadata, fresh outputs outside source/dependency trees including aliases, parseable wrong-archive rejection; identity/digest bypass controls
Existing directories, directory symlinks and dangling symlinks preserve prior evidence and invoke no west command

infrastructure.preparation: Explicit pinned offline workspace; local unchanged ZMK clone and original fixture manifest; no fetch or source repair
infrastructure.limits: Admission tests control dependency responses. Actual native/API/firmware fixtures separately verify unchanged stock ZMK and DYA. Physical transport remains separate.

suppression_extraction: tests/README.md: source buttons/sync stay unchanged; final owner owns paired disposition, repeats, unmatched releases and pending frames.
scheduled_work_settings_review: The two-node settings fixture preserves all primary range/read assertions and runs them on both macro expansions. It tests every own/peer descriptor, ignored foreign events and boot application to both nodes. Targeted dispatch avoids foreign edits incrementing another node's contact generation. Source-button transparency, layer claims and final-mask composition retain their existing assertions.
concurrent_settings: DYA native integration now explicitly enables the actual settings adapter and registry. A linker wrapper pauses the last real registry read in writer A while writer B commits another field, then verifies the newest width and enabled values. The adapter mutex serializes the full read/apply transaction. Eight existing native groups remain on both cores; DYA adds this ninth group, one binary three times. For standalone DYA native checks set ZMK_TEST_CUSTOM_SETTINGS=1 with the pinned registry workspace. No production test hook or filter dependency is introduced.
selected_workspace: Workspace selection uses tests/integration/workspace-env.sh to export the selected manifest's ZEPHYR_MODULES and explicit Zephyr package/base paths. A Zephyr symlink to a different cache must not select that cache's module providers. The owner test_workspace_env.py exercises actual selection with a poisoned ambient list, a cache symlink, module paths containing spaces, failed project discovery and an empty selection. The keep-ambient negative control must fail these assertions. Full integration retains all supported-core, role, persistence and invalid-DTS cases. No dependency is patched or required feature disabled.
